#GENERAL RULES
##Language
- CMU is an English-only server. Borrowed words or phrases in other languages are allowed if done to complement your RP (your character referring to their "padre", "amigo", etc. is fine).
- You may only use standard English characters and punctuation in chat, announcements, or object labels. - Emojis, symbol spamming, or other gibberish is forbidden.
##Do not Metagame
- You may only use information you gained from your character's perspective. - Use of information you gained in out-of-character ways to gain an advantage is forbidden.
- Your character may remember all events up until you fall unconscious. - You forget everything after taking a ghostrole or respawning unless otherwise stated.
- Do not post images/videos of or discuss ongoing rounds until after the round has concluded. Exceptions may be given out please contact the Head Moderator if you wish for an exception.
- Players may be in a voice chat with each other while playing the game, but must not share information that could be used to metagame.
- Retrieving or completing objectives for a faction as a third party or unrelated party, without being informed of that faction’s objectives, is considered metagaming.
- Using game mechanics like emotes or the right-click menu to locate players or entities in, for example, dark areas is considered metagaming. This, however, does not apply to Emotes that produce sounds like laughing.
##Don't be Annoying
- Do not annoy other players for your own amusement.
- Do not intentionally and majorly distrupt the cohesion of your faction. - There is leeway for minor and moderate crimes that benefit your character.
- Do not spam emotes/sounds for no reason (this includes screaming, reload spam, etc.).
- Do not make other players feel uncomfortable; don't make weird or out-of-pocket comments about players or their character(s), especially if they tell you to stop.
